g.text: Figure 1: Aegis Agent Governance — Statistical Evaluation, FinOps Arbitrage & Runtime Control Plane
Decoupled Control Architecture: Non-Invasive Middleware → Entropy-Gated Edge/Cloud Router → Streaming Circuit Breaker & Stateful MCP → Statistical CI/CD Gate (TDI, SPRT, ECRT)
Fallback Guard: Invalid local JSON auto-escalates to Cloud
B. Local Edge Tier: Apple M5 Pro (48 GB Unified RAM)
Live Ollama / MLX Execution • Amortized CapEx + 42W Wall-Plug OpEx
Local TCO Formula: C_local = (CapEx/T_amort + P_kW·r_kWh) × Δt
C. Frontier Cloud Escalation Tier (High-Entropy Only)
Invoked strictly when H(x) ≥ 0.65 or local schema validation fails
⚡ Hybrid SQL Pipeline Result: 68.5% Net Cloud Spend Saved
Trips before runaway API billing spikes
• Canonicalizes nested JSON args for graph hashing
Aegis Pointer: 42-byte URI + JSON diff patch
Backed by Redis TTL cache + in-memory fallback
• Catches stochastic tool drift invisible to Pass@k
B. Wald's SPRT & ECRT Unit Economics
Sequential Probability Ratio Test + Cost Gate
ECRT = (Σ C_local,i + Σ C_cloud,i) / Σ I(Resolved_i)
Halts CI rollouts as soon as log-likelihood ratio
✔ Blocks PR Merge on TDI / ECRT Regression
GitHub Actions Gate + CLI: aegis evaluate / profile-mcp

svg.text: Closed-Loop Governance: Enforce TDI ≥ 0.85, ECRT Ceiling & Circuit Breaker Policies in CI/CD
